run_adsorb_atoms: run adsorb_atoms to relax an adslab system and compute adsorption energy using an ASE calculator
compute_hybrid_adsorption_energy: compute hybrid adsorption energy by combining ML-relaxed adslab energies with DFT slab reference energies
relax_adsorbate_surface_system: relax an adsorbate plus surface atoms object with a configurable force convergence threshold and max steps
compute_full_ml_adsorption: compute full ML adsorption energy by relaxing both the adslab and bare surface with the same calculator
save_relaxed_atoms_json: save relaxed adslab and slab atoms as JSON-encoded strings in the adsorption results dictionary
